_doc: mozak spec attach: attach the spec file to a plan whose direction the owner approved. Copy, replace the values, keep every key (closed schema). Build with scripts/make_request.py attach-spec <this file>. acceptedRevisionId = the plan's accepted revision (`plans --json`: groups.open.rows[].revisionId). path is relative to the scope root, no ./ prefix. bounds needs all five keys. outcomeChecks items are {outcomeId, criterion}. Attaching grants nothing: implementation approval is a separate owner decision.

bounds.summary: Only the Erasmus application documents in this folder.

outcomeChecks.criterion: Fabijan confirms the portal shows the application as submitted.
